ny-ad-24/david-weprin.title: Prohibits the use of restraints on incarcerated individuals during labor, absent extraordinary circumstances, and on pregnant persons during a custodial interrogation
ny-ad-24/david-weprin.summary: Prohibits the use of restraints on and the use of force against incarcerated individuals during labor and incarcerated individuals who have experienced different pregnancy outcomes, absent extraordinary circumstances, and on pregnant and post-pregnancy persons during a custodial interrogation; provides for certain exceptions for restraints to be used and in such case limits the use to wrist restraints.

ny-ad-24/david-weprin.title: Requires elections and terms of certain officials occur on even-numbered years except in the city of New York
ny-ad-24/david-weprin.summary: Requires certain elections take place in even-numbered years for certain municipal and judicial officials except in the city of New York.

ny-ad-24/david-weprin.title: Permits the town of Monroe to impose a hotel and motel tax
ny-ad-24/david-weprin.summary: Permits the town of Monroe to impose a hotel and motel tax; provides for the repeal of such provisions upon the expiration thereof.

ny-ad-24/david-weprin.title: Authorizes an occupancy tax in the city of Oneonta
ny-ad-24/david-weprin.summary: Authorizes an occupancy tax in the city of Oneonta not to exceed 6%.

ny-ad-24/david-weprin.title: Establishes the New York dignity in pregnancy and childbirth act and requires hospitals and other facilities that provide perinatal care to implement an evidence-based implicit bias program
ny-ad-24/david-weprin.summary: Establishes the New York dignity in pregnancy and childbirth act; requires hospitals and other facilities that provide perinatal care to implement an evidence-based implicit bias program for all health care providers involved in the perinatal care of patients within those facilities; requires the department of health to publish reports on maternal morbidity and pregnancy related deaths.

ny-ad-24/david-weprin.title: Authorizes the village of Atlantic Beach to impose a hotel, motel and beach club tax
ny-ad-24/david-weprin.summary: Authorizes the village of Atlantic Beach, county of Nassau to impose a three percent hotel, motel and beach club tax; defines "beach club" as a facility formed, organized or operated by any person, firm or corporation, located on or contiguous to an ocean beach, permitting sunbathing, swimming and other allied recreation activities, including such uses operated by a hotel, cooperative complex or other entity; makes related provisions.

ny-ad-24/david-weprin.title: Provides internet access to all individuals residing in temporary housing
ny-ad-24/david-weprin.summary: Provides WiFi service and internet access to all individuals residing in temporary housing; relates to funding for internet service under the ConnectAll digital equity grant program.

ny-ad-24/david-weprin.title: Authorizes the county of Putnam to lease certain lands used as parklands
ny-ad-24/david-weprin.summary: Authorizes the county of Putnam to lease certain lands used as parklands in the town of Carmel for use as a cell tower for thirty years.

ny-ad-24/david-weprin.title: Authorizes the village of Ellicottville to impose a hotel and motel tax

ny-ad-24/david-weprin.title: Authorizes the town of Minisink to impose a hotel and motel tax
ny-ad-24/david-weprin.summary: Authorizes the town of Minisink to impose a hotel and motel tax at a rate of five percent.

ny-ad-24/david-weprin.title: Increases the distribution of revenue from extending the authorization for the hotel and motel taxes in Suffolk county
ny-ad-24/david-weprin.summary: Increases the distribution of revenue from extending the authorization for the hotel and motel taxes in Suffolk county; provides for the support of a not-for-profit organization that manages and owns the first lighthouse built in New York, a national register of historic places site in Suffolk county that has been named a national historic landmark and is a New York state historic site.

ny-ad-24/david-weprin.title: Enacts the responsible data center development act

ny-ad-24/david-weprin.title: Enacts into law necessary legislation including extensions and technical corrections

ny-ad-24/david-weprin.title: Relates to the taxation of vapor products
ny-ad-24/david-weprin.summary: Relates to the taxation of vapor products; provides for the licensing of vapor products distributors; imposes certain tax return filing requirements on vapor products distributors; provides for enforcement powers.

ny-ad-24/david-weprin.title: Establishes a school speed zone camera demonstration program in the city of Amsterdam
ny-ad-24/david-weprin.summary: Establishes a school speed zone camera demonstration program in the city of Amsterdam; repeals authorization of such program on December 31, 2031.

ny-ad-24/david-weprin.title: Relates to judicial districts

ny-ad-33/clyde-vanel.title: Establishes the New York dignity in pregnancy and childbirth act and requires hospitals and other facilities that provide perinatal care to implement an evidence-based implicit bias program
ny-ad-33/clyde-vanel.summary: Establishes the New York dignity in pregnancy and childbirth act; requires hospitals and other facilities that provide perinatal care to implement an evidence-based implicit bias program for all health care providers involved in the perinatal care of patients within those facilities; requires the department of health to publish reports on maternal morbidity and pregnancy related deaths.

ny-ad-33/clyde-vanel.title: Authorizes the village of Atlantic Beach to impose a hotel, motel and beach club tax
ny-ad-33/clyde-vanel.summary: Authorizes the village of Atlantic Beach, county of Nassau to impose a three percent hotel, motel and beach club tax; defines "beach club" as a facility formed, organized or operated by any person, firm or corporation, located on or contiguous to an ocean beach, permitting sunbathing, swimming and other allied recreation activities, including such uses operated by a hotel, cooperative complex or other entity; makes related provisions.

ny-ad-33/clyde-vanel.title: Provides internet access to all individuals residing in temporary housing
ny-ad-33/clyde-vanel.summary: Provides WiFi service and internet access to all individuals residing in temporary housing; relates to funding for internet service under the ConnectAll digital equity grant program.

ny-ad-33/clyde-vanel.title: Authorizes the county of Putnam to lease certain lands used as parklands
ny-ad-33/clyde-vanel.summary: Authorizes the county of Putnam to lease certain lands used as parklands in the town of Carmel for use as a cell tower for thirty years.

ny-ad-33/clyde-vanel.title: Authorizes the village of Ellicottville to impose a hotel and motel tax
ny-ad-33/clyde-vanel.summary: Authorizes the village of Ellicottville to impose a hotel and motel tax not exceeding five percent of the per diem rental rate for each room.

ny-ad-33/clyde-vanel.title: Establishes a school speed zone camera demonstration program in the city of Ithaca
ny-ad-33/clyde-vanel.summary: Establishes a school speed zone camera demonstration program in the city of Ithaca; repeals authorization of such program on December 31, 2030.

ny-ad-33/clyde-vanel.title: Authorizes the town of Minisink to impose a hotel and motel tax
ny-ad-33/clyde-vanel.summary: Authorizes the town of Minisink to impose a hotel and motel tax at a rate of five percent.

ny-ad-33/clyde-vanel.title: Increases the distribution of revenue from extending the authorization for the hotel and motel taxes in Suffolk county
ny-ad-33/clyde-vanel.summary: Increases the distribution of revenue from extending the authorization for the hotel and motel taxes in Suffolk county; provides for the support of a not-for-profit organization that manages and owns the first lighthouse built in New York, a national register of historic places site in Suffolk county that has been named a national historic landmark and is a New York state historic site.

ny-ad-33/clyde-vanel.title: Enacts the responsible data center development act
ny-ad-33/clyde-vanel.summary: Places a one year moratorium on the issuance of data center permits; requires utilities to establish an independent classification of service for large data centers; sets energy efficiency goals for data centers; provides for benefits for host communities; sets labor standards for the construction of data centers.

ny-ad-33/clyde-vanel.title: Enacts into law necessary legislation including extensions and technical corrections
ny-ad-33/clyde-vanel.summary: Extends the demonstration project and workgroup to reduce the use of temporary staffing agencies in residential healthcare facilities for a fifth year, until December 31, 2027 (Part A); extends the duration of certain brownfield redevelopment and remediation tax credits with respect to a site located at 1800 Park Avenue (Part B); makes technical corrections relating to extending the term and authority of the independent monitor for the Orange county IDA (Part C); extends the demonstration project and workgroup to reduce the use of temporary staffing agencies in residential healthcare facilities for a fifth year, until December 31, 2027 (Part D); makes technical corrections to section 11-3206 of the administrative code of the city of New York (Part E); provides for the temporary transfer of racing support payments (Part F).

ny-ad-33/clyde-vanel.title: Relates to the taxation of vapor products
ny-ad-33/clyde-vanel.summary: Relates to the taxation of vapor products; provides for the licensing of vapor products distributors; imposes certain tax return filing requirements on vapor products distributors; provides for enforcement powers.

ny-ad-33/clyde-vanel.title: Establishes a school speed zone camera demonstration program in the city of Amsterdam
ny-ad-33/clyde-vanel.summary: Establishes a school speed zone camera demonstration program in the city of Amsterdam; repeals authorization of such program on December 31, 2031.

ny-ad-33/clyde-vanel.title: Authorizes the town of Greenburgh to alienate and discontinue the use of certain parkland
ny-ad-33/clyde-vanel.summary: Authorizes the town of Greenburgh to alienate and discontinue the use of certain parkland and to lease such land to HESP Solar LLC for a term not to exceed twenty-five years.

ny-ad-33/clyde-vanel.title: Relates to judicial districts
ny-ad-33/clyde-vanel.summary: Provides that in the fourth judicial department, three new districts, fourteen, fifteen and sixteen are added; makes related provisions.

ny-ad-33/clyde-vanel.title: Relates to establishing minimum standards for payment plans for eligible customers
ny-ad-33/clyde-vanel.summary: Relates to establishing minimum standards for payment plans for eligible customers; requires the public service commission to set standards for payment plans for certain customers including reasonableness of agreements and timelines for payment; establishes eligibility.

ny-ad-33/clyde-vanel.title: Provides remedies for disrupted elections

ny-ad-47/william-colton.title: Requires elections and terms of certain officials occur on even-numbered years except in the city of New York
ny-ad-47/william-colton.summary: Requires certain elections take place in even-numbered years for certain municipal and judicial officials except in the city of New York.

ny-ad-47/william-colton.title: Permits the town of Monroe to impose a hotel and motel tax
ny-ad-47/william-colton.summary: Permits the town of Monroe to impose a hotel and motel tax; provides for the repeal of such provisions upon the expiration thereof.

ny-ad-47/william-colton.title: Authorizes an occupancy tax in the city of Oneonta
ny-ad-47/william-colton.summary: Authorizes an occupancy tax in the city of Oneonta not to exceed 6%.

ny-ad-47/william-colton.title: Establishes the New York dignity in pregnancy and childbirth act and requires hospitals and other facilities that provide perinatal care to implement an evidence-based implicit bias program
ny-ad-47/william-colton.summary: Establishes the New York dignity in pregnancy and childbirth act; requires hospitals and other facilities that provide perinatal care to implement an evidence-based implicit bias program for all health care providers involved in the perinatal care of patients within those facilities; requires the department of health to publish reports on maternal morbidity and pregnancy related deaths.

ny-ad-47/william-colton.title: Authorizes the village of Atlantic Beach to impose a hotel, motel and beach club tax
ny-ad-47/william-colton.summary: Authorizes the village of Atlantic Beach, county of Nassau to impose a three percent hotel, motel and beach club tax; defines "beach club" as a facility formed, organized or operated by any person, firm or corporation, located on or contiguous to an ocean beach, permitting sunbathing, swimming and other allied recreation activities, including such uses operated by a hotel, cooperative complex or other entity; makes related provisions.

ny-ad-47/william-colton.title: Provides internet access to all individuals residing in temporary housing
ny-ad-47/william-colton.summary: Provides WiFi service and internet access to all individuals residing in temporary housing; relates to funding for internet service under the ConnectAll digital equity grant program.

ny-ad-47/william-colton.title: Authorizes the county of Putnam to lease certain lands used as parklands
ny-ad-47/william-colton.summary: Authorizes the county of Putnam to lease certain lands used as parklands in the town of Carmel for use as a cell tower for thirty years.

ny-ad-47/william-colton.title: Authorizes the village of Ellicottville to impose a hotel and motel tax
ny-ad-47/william-colton.summary: Authorizes the village of Ellicottville to impose a hotel and motel tax not exceeding five percent of the per diem rental rate for each room.

ny-ad-47/william-colton.title: Establishes a school speed zone camera demonstration program in the city of Ithaca
ny-ad-47/william-colton.summary: Establishes a school speed zone camera demonstration program in the city of Ithaca; repeals authorization of such program on December 31, 2030.

ny-ad-47/william-colton.title: Authorizes the town of Minisink to impose a hotel and motel tax
ny-ad-47/william-colton.summary: Authorizes the town of Minisink to impose a hotel and motel tax at a rate of five percent.

ny-ad-47/william-colton.title: Increases the distribution of revenue from extending the authorization for the hotel and motel taxes in Suffolk county
ny-ad-47/william-colton.summary: Increases the distribution of revenue from extending the authorization for the hotel and motel taxes in Suffolk county; provides for the support of a not-for-profit organization that manages and owns the first lighthouse built in New York, a national register of historic places site in Suffolk county that has been named a national historic landmark and is a New York state historic site.

ny-ad-47/william-colton.title: Enacts the responsible data center development act
ny-ad-47/william-colton.summary: Places a one year moratorium on the issuance of data center permits; requires utilities to establish an independent classification of service for large data centers; sets energy efficiency goals for data centers; provides for benefits for host communities; sets labor standards for the construction of data centers.

ny-ad-47/william-colton.title: Enacts into law necessary legislation including extensions and technical corrections
ny-ad-47/william-colton.summary: Extends the demonstration project and workgroup to reduce the use of temporary staffing agencies in residential healthcare facilities for a fifth year, until December 31, 2027 (Part A); extends the duration of certain brownfield redevelopment and remediation tax credits with respect to a site located at 1800 Park Avenue (Part B); makes technical corrections relating to extending the term and authority of the independent monitor for the Orange county IDA (Part C); extends the demonstration project and workgroup to reduce the use of temporary staffing agencies in residential healthcare facilities for a fifth year, until December 31, 2027 (Part D); makes technical corrections to section 11-3206 of the administrative code of the city of New York (Part E); provides for the temporary transfer of racing support payments (Part F).

ny-ad-47/william-colton.title: Relates to the taxation of vapor products
ny-ad-47/william-colton.summary: Relates to the taxation of vapor products; provides for the licensing of vapor products distributors; imposes certain tax return filing requirements on vapor products distributors; provides for enforcement powers.

ny-ad-47/william-colton.title: Establishes a school speed zone camera demonstration program in the city of Amsterdam
ny-ad-47/william-colton.summary: Establishes a school speed zone camera demonstration program in the city of Amsterdam; repeals authorization of such program on December 31, 2031.

ny-ad-47/william-colton.title: Establishes a school speed zone camera demonstration program in the city of Yonkers
ny-ad-47/william-colton.summary: Establishes a school speed zone camera demonstration program in the city of Yonkers; repeals authorization of program December 31, 2031.

ny-ad-47/william-colton.title: Authorizes the town of Greenburgh to alienate and discontinue the use of certain parkland
ny-ad-47/william-colton.summary: Authorizes the town of Greenburgh to alienate and discontinue the use of certain parkland and to lease such land to HESP Solar LLC for a term not to exceed twenty-five years.

ny-ad-47/william-colton.title: Relates to judicial districts
ny-ad-47/william-colton.summary: Provides that in the fourth judicial department, three new districts, fourteen, fifteen and sixteen are added; makes related provisions.

ny-ad-47/william-colton.title: Relates to establishing minimum standards for payment plans for eligible customers
ny-ad-47/william-colton.summary: Relates to establishing minimum standards for payment plans for eligible customers; requires the public service commission to set standards for payment plans for certain customers including reasonableness of agreements and timelines for payment; establishes eligibility.

ny-ad-47/william-colton.title: Provides remedies for disrupted elections
ny-ad-47/william-colton.summary: Provides remedies for disrupted voting times and locations during elections; directs that the BOE extend voting to account for the disruption.

ny-ad-55/latrice-walker.summary: Authorizes the county of Putnam to lease certain lands used as parklands in the town of Carmel for use as a cell tower for thirty years.

ny-ad-55/latrice-walker.title: Authorizes the village of Ellicottville to impose a hotel and motel tax
ny-ad-55/latrice-walker.summary: Authorizes the village of Ellicottville to impose a hotel and motel tax not exceeding five percent of the per diem rental rate for each room.

ny-ad-55/latrice-walker.title: Establishes a school speed zone camera demonstration program in the city of Ithaca
ny-ad-55/latrice-walker.summary: Establishes a school speed zone camera demonstration program in the city of Ithaca; repeals authorization of such program on December 31, 2030.

ny-ad-55/latrice-walker.title: Authorizes the town of Minisink to impose a hotel and motel tax

ny-ad-55/latrice-walker.title: Increases the distribution of revenue from extending the authorization for the hotel and motel taxes in Suffolk county
ny-ad-55/latrice-walker.summary: Increases the distribution of revenue from extending the authorization for the hotel and motel taxes in Suffolk county; provides for the support of a not-for-profit organization that manages and owns the first lighthouse built in New York, a national register of historic places site in Suffolk county that has been named a national historic landmark and is a New York state historic site.

ny-ad-55/latrice-walker.title: Enacts the responsible data center development act

ny-ad-55/latrice-walker.title: Enacts into law necessary legislation including extensions and technical corrections
ny-ad-55/latrice-walker.summary: Extends the demonstration project and workgroup to reduce the use of temporary staffing agencies in residential healthcare facilities for a fifth year, until December 31, 2027 (Part A); extends the duration of certain brownfield redevelopment and remediation tax credits with respect to a site located at 1800 Park Avenue (Part B); makes technical corrections relating to extending the term and authority of the independent monitor for the Orange county IDA (Part C); extends the demonstration project and workgroup to reduce the use of temporary staffing agencies in residential healthcare facilities for a fifth year, until December 31, 2027 (Part D); makes technical corrections to section 11-3206 of the administrative code of the city of New York (Part E); provides for the temporary transfer of racing support payments (Part F).

ny-ad-55/latrice-walker.title: Relates to the taxation of vapor products
ny-ad-55/latrice-walker.summary: Relates to the taxation of vapor products; provides for the licensing of vapor products distributors; imposes certain tax return filing requirements on vapor products distributors; provides for enforcement powers.

ny-ad-55/latrice-walker.title: Establishes a school speed zone camera demonstration program in the city of Amsterdam
ny-ad-55/latrice-walker.summary: Establishes a school speed zone camera demonstration program in the city of Amsterdam; repeals authorization of such program on December 31, 2031.

ny-ad-55/latrice-walker.title: Authorizes the town of Greenburgh to alienate and discontinue the use of certain parkland
ny-ad-55/latrice-walker.summary: Authorizes the town of Greenburgh to alienate and discontinue the use of certain parkland and to lease such land to HESP Solar LLC for a term not to exceed twenty-five years.

ny-ad-55/latrice-walker.title: Relates to judicial districts
ny-ad-55/latrice-walker.summary: Provides that in the fourth judicial department, three new districts, fourteen, fifteen and sixteen are added; makes related provisions.

ny-ad-71/alfred-taylor.title: Authorizes an occupancy tax in the city of Oneonta

ny-ad-71/alfred-taylor.title: Establishes the New York dignity in pregnancy and childbirth act and requires hospitals and other facilities that provide perinatal care to implement an evidence-based implicit bias program
ny-ad-71/alfred-taylor.summary: Establishes the New York dignity in pregnancy and childbirth act; requires hospitals and other facilities that provide perinatal care to implement an evidence-based implicit bias program for all health care providers involved in the perinatal care of patients within those facilities; requires the department of health to publish reports on maternal morbidity and pregnancy related deaths.

ny-ad-71/alfred-taylor.title: Authorizes the village of Atlantic Beach to impose a hotel, motel and beach club tax
ny-ad-71/alfred-taylor.summary: Authorizes the village of Atlantic Beach, county of Nassau to impose a three percent hotel, motel and beach club tax; defines "beach club" as a facility formed, organized or operated by any person, firm or corporation, located on or contiguous to an ocean beach, permitting sunbathing, swimming and other allied recreation activities, including such uses operated by a hotel, cooperative complex or other entity; makes related provisions.

ny-ad-71/alfred-taylor.title: Provides internet access to all individuals residing in temporary housing
ny-ad-71/alfred-taylor.summary: Provides WiFi service and internet access to all individuals residing in temporary housing; relates to funding for internet service under the ConnectAll digital equity grant program.

ny-ad-71/alfred-taylor.title: Authorizes the county of Putnam to lease certain lands used as parklands
ny-ad-71/alfred-taylor.summary: Authorizes the county of Putnam to lease certain lands used as parklands in the town of Carmel for use as a cell tower for thirty years.

ny-ad-71/alfred-taylor.title: Authorizes the village of Ellicottville to impose a hotel and motel tax
ny-ad-71/alfred-taylor.summary: Authorizes the village of Ellicottville to impose a hotel and motel tax not exceeding five percent of the per diem rental rate for each room.

ny-ad-71/alfred-taylor.title: Establishes a school speed zone camera demonstration program in the city of Ithaca
ny-ad-71/alfred-taylor.summary: Establishes a school speed zone camera demonstration program in the city of Ithaca; repeals authorization of such program on December 31, 2030.

ny-ad-71/alfred-taylor.title: Authorizes the town of Minisink to impose a hotel and motel tax
ny-ad-71/alfred-taylor.summary: Authorizes the town of Minisink to impose a hotel and motel tax at a rate of five percent.

ny-ad-71/alfred-taylor.title: Increases the distribution of revenue from extending the authorization for the hotel and motel taxes in Suffolk county
ny-ad-71/alfred-taylor.summary: Increases the distribution of revenue from extending the authorization for the hotel and motel taxes in Suffolk county; provides for the support of a not-for-profit organization that manages and owns the first lighthouse built in New York, a national register of historic places site in Suffolk county that has been named a national historic landmark and is a New York state historic site.

ny-ad-71/alfred-taylor.title: Enacts the responsible data center development act

ny-ad-71/alfred-taylor.title: Enacts into law necessary legislation including extensions and technical corrections
ny-ad-71/alfred-taylor.summary: Extends the demonstration project and workgroup to reduce the use of temporary staffing agencies in residential healthcare facilities for a fifth year, until December 31, 2027 (Part A); extends the duration of certain brownfield redevelopment and remediation tax credits with respect to a site located at 1800 Park Avenue (Part B); makes technical corrections relating to extending the term and authority of the independent monitor for the Orange county IDA (Part C); extends the demonstration project and workgroup to reduce the use of temporary staffing agencies in residential healthcare facilities for a fifth year, until December 31, 2027 (Part D); makes technical corrections to section 11-3206 of the administrative code of the city of New York (Part E); provides for the temporary transfer of racing support payments (Part F).

ny-ad-71/alfred-taylor.title: Relates to the taxation of vapor products

ny-ad-71/alfred-taylor.title: Establishes a school speed zone camera demonstration program in the city of Amsterdam
ny-ad-71/alfred-taylor.summary: Establishes a school speed zone camera demonstration program in the city of Amsterdam; repeals authorization of such program on December 31, 2031.

ny-ad-71/alfred-taylor.title: Authorizes the town of Greenburgh to alienate and discontinue the use of certain parkland

ny-ad-71/alfred-taylor.title: Relates to judicial districts

ny-sd-10/james-sanders-jr.title: Relates to information that residential health care facilities are required to disclose to residents and their families
ny-sd-10/james-sanders-jr.summary: Relates to information that residential health care facilities are required to separately disclose to residents and their families; requires such information to be posted on the residential health care facility's website.

ny-sd-10/james-sanders-jr.title: Enacts the "police radio transparency act"
ny-sd-10/james-sanders-jr.summary: Requires that any law enforcement agency in the state that encrypts any portion of its radio communications shall ensure that all of its radio communications, with the exception of sensitive information, may be monitored in real time by professional journalists, newscasters, and individuals employed by emergency services organizations.

ny-sd-10/james-sanders-jr.title: Relates to license fees required to be paid by wholesale beer licensees to sell cider
ny-sd-10/james-sanders-jr.summary: Requires wholesale beer licensees to only need to pay a one time additional license fee to sell cider.

ny-sd-10/james-sanders-jr.title: Enacts the responsible data center development act
ny-sd-10/james-sanders-jr.summary: Places a one year moratorium on the issuance of data center permits; requires utilities to establish an independent classification of service for large data centers; sets energy efficiency goals for data centers; provides for benefits for host communities; sets labor standards for the construction of data centers.

ny-sd-10/james-sanders-jr.title: Requires the division of criminal justice services to study the technological viability of personalized firearms
ny-sd-10/james-sanders-jr.summary: Enacts the "safer weapons, safer homes act"; requires the division of criminal justice services to study the technological viability of personalized firearms; defines personalized firearms; requires the division to report to the governor and the legislature on the results of the study.

ny-sd-10/james-sanders-jr.title: Promotes consumer choice by requiring manufacturers of digital electronic equipment to provide retail sellers with a one through ten repair score that will be displayed to consumers at point of sale
ny-sd-10/james-sanders-jr.summary: Promotes consumer choice by requiring manufacturers of digital electronic equipment to provide retail sellers with a repair score that will be displayed to consumers at point of sale.

ny-sd-10/james-sanders-jr.title: Relates to the taxation of vapor products
ny-sd-10/james-sanders-jr.summary: Relates to the taxation of vapor products; provides for the licensing of vapor products distributors; imposes certain tax return filing requirements on vapor products distributors; provides for enforcement powers.

ny-sd-10/james-sanders-jr.title: Relates to training for school security guards
ny-sd-10/james-sanders-jr.summary: Enacts the "school security guard training enhancement act"; provides that annual training where a security guard is employed or contracted by a school in this state shall require the completion of school specific-training.

ny-sd-10/james-sanders-jr.title: Relates to the municipal sustainable energy loan program
ny-sd-10/james-sanders-jr.summary: Relates to the municipal sustainable energy loan program regarding qualifying water improvements, qualifying resiliency improvements and, in a city with a population of one million or more, the use of low carbon intensity building components.

ny-sd-10/james-sanders-jr.title: Relates to the contents of emergency response plans required to be submitted to the public service commission by electric corporations
ny-sd-10/james-sanders-jr.summary: Relates to the contents of emergency response plans required to be submitted to the public service commission by electric corporations; requires such plans to include details of staffing, equipment, and ability to perform toward certain standards; requires the public service commission to establish a time-based restoration schedule.

ny-sd-10/james-sanders-jr.title: Establishes the artificial intelligence training data transparency act
ny-sd-10/james-sanders-jr.summary: Establishes the artificial intelligence training data transparency act requiring developers of generative artificial intelligence models or services to post on the developer's website information regarding the data used by the developer to train the generative artificial intelligence model or service, including a high-level summary of the datasets used in the development of such system or service.

ny-sd-10/james-sanders-jr.title: Enacts "the construction reporting pay act"
ny-sd-10/james-sanders-jr.summary: Enacts "the construction reporting pay act"; provides that each laborer, worker or mechanic in the employ of a contractor who by request or permission of an employer reports for work on any day shall be paid no less than four hours at the prevailing rate of wages.

ny-sd-10/james-sanders-jr.title: Permits funds collected from the Oswego county occupancy tax to be used on making tourism related capital improvements
ny-sd-10/james-sanders-jr.summary: Permits funds collected from the Oswego county occupancy tax to be used on making tourism related capital improvements; removes such tax on permanent residents.

ny-sd-10/james-sanders-jr.title: Designates dog control officers of the village of Holley, named by the village board as constables, as peace officers
ny-sd-10/james-sanders-jr.summary: Designates dog control officers of the village of Holley, named by the village board as constables, as peace officers.

ny-sd-10/james-sanders-jr.title: Provides liability protections for health care providers who issue vaccines
ny-sd-10/james-sanders-jr.summary: Provides liability protections for health care providers who issue vaccines so long as such vaccination does not arise out of willful misconduct or gross negligence.

ny-sd-10/james-sanders-jr.title: Prohibits the use of surveillance pricing
ny-sd-10/james-sanders-jr.summary: Prohibits the use of surveillance pricing, directly or indirectly; prohibits the collection, use, retention, or sharing of data to facilitate surveillance pricing; provides exceptions; provides for enforcement by the attorney general; makes related provisions.

ny-sd-10/james-sanders-jr.title: Requires covered businesses to annually report to the department of labor regarding the impact of artificial intelligence on hiring and the nature of artificial intelligence use
ny-sd-10/james-sanders-jr.summary: Requires covered businesses to annually report to the department of labor regarding the impact of artificial intelligence on hiring and the nature of artificial intelligence use for the previous year; requires the department of labor to file an annual report on the impact of artificial intelligence on hiring and the nature of artificial intelligence use in the state; establishes penalties for covered business that fail to submit such reports.

ny-sd-18/julia-salazar.title: Relates to training for school security guards
ny-sd-18/julia-salazar.summary: Enacts the "school security guard training enhancement act"; provides that annual training where a security guard is employed or contracted by a school in this state shall require the completion of school specific-training.

ny-sd-18/julia-salazar.title: Relates to the municipal sustainable energy loan program
ny-sd-18/julia-salazar.summary: Relates to the municipal sustainable energy loan program regarding qualifying water improvements, qualifying resiliency improvements and, in a city with a population of one million or more, the use of low carbon intensity building components.

ny-sd-18/julia-salazar.title: Relates to the contents of emergency response plans required to be submitted to the public service commission by electric corporations
ny-sd-18/julia-salazar.summary: Relates to the contents of emergency response plans required to be submitted to the public service commission by electric corporations; requires such plans to include details of staffing, equipment, and ability to perform toward certain standards; requires the public service commission to establish a time-based restoration schedule.

ny-sd-18/julia-salazar.title: Establishes the artificial intelligence training data transparency act
ny-sd-18/julia-salazar.summary: Establishes the artificial intelligence training data transparency act requiring developers of generative artificial intelligence models or services to post on the developer's website information regarding the data used by the developer to train the generative artificial intelligence model or service, including a high-level summary of the datasets used in the development of such system or service.

ny-sd-18/julia-salazar.title: Enacts "the construction reporting pay act"
ny-sd-18/julia-salazar.summary: Enacts "the construction reporting pay act"; provides that each laborer, worker or mechanic in the employ of a contractor who by request or permission of an employer reports for work on any day shall be paid no less than four hours at the prevailing rate of wages.

ny-sd-18/julia-salazar.title: Permits funds collected from the Oswego county occupancy tax to be used on making tourism related capital improvements
ny-sd-18/julia-salazar.summary: Permits funds collected from the Oswego county occupancy tax to be used on making tourism related capital improvements; removes such tax on permanent residents.

ny-sd-18/julia-salazar.title: Designates dog control officers of the village of Holley, named by the village board as constables, as peace officers
ny-sd-18/julia-salazar.summary: Designates dog control officers of the village of Holley, named by the village board as constables, as peace officers.

ny-sd-18/julia-salazar.title: Provides liability protections for health care providers who issue vaccines
ny-sd-18/julia-salazar.summary: Provides liability protections for health care providers who issue vaccines so long as such vaccination does not arise out of willful misconduct or gross negligence.

ny-sd-18/julia-salazar.title: Prohibits the use of surveillance pricing
ny-sd-18/julia-salazar.summary: Prohibits the use of surveillance pricing, directly or indirectly; prohibits the collection, use, retention, or sharing of data to facilitate surveillance pricing; provides exceptions; provides for enforcement by the attorney general; makes related provisions.

ny-sd-18/julia-salazar.title: Requires covered businesses to annually report to the department of labor regarding the impact of artificial intelligence on hiring and the nature of artificial intelligence use
ny-sd-18/julia-salazar.summary: Requires covered businesses to annually report to the department of labor regarding the impact of artificial intelligence on hiring and the nature of artificial intelligence use for the previous year; requires the department of labor to file an annual report on the impact of artificial intelligence on hiring and the nature of artificial intelligence use in the state; establishes penalties for covered business that fail to submit such reports.

ny-sd-19/roxanne-persaud.summary: Relates to information that residential health care facilities are required to separately disclose to residents and their families; requires such information to be posted on the residential health care facility's website.

ny-sd-19/roxanne-persaud.title: Enacts the "police radio transparency act"
ny-sd-19/roxanne-persaud.summary: Requires that any law enforcement agency in the state that encrypts any portion of its radio communications shall ensure that all of its radio communications, with the exception of sensitive information, may be monitored in real time by professional journalists, newscasters, and individuals employed by emergency services organizations.

ny-sd-19/roxanne-persaud.title: Relates to license fees required to be paid by wholesale beer licensees to sell cider
ny-sd-19/roxanne-persaud.summary: Requires wholesale beer licensees to only need to pay a one time additional license fee to sell cider.

ny-sd-19/roxanne-persaud.summary: Enacts the "safer weapons, safer homes act"; requires the division of criminal justice services to study the technological viability of personalized firearms; defines personalized firearms; requires the division to report to the governor and the legislature on the results of the study.

ny-sd-22/sam-sutton.title: Requires covered businesses to annually report to the department of labor regarding the impact of artificial intelligence on hiring and the nature of artificial intelligence use
ny-sd-22/sam-sutton.summary: Requires covered businesses to annually report to the department of labor regarding the impact of artificial intelligence on hiring and the nature of artificial intelligence use for the previous year; requires the department of labor to file an annual report on the impact of artificial intelligence on hiring and the nature of artificial intelligence use in the state; establishes penalties for covered business that fail to submit such reports.

ny-sd-23/jessica-scarcella-spanton.title: Relates to information that residential health care facilities are required to disclose to residents and their families
ny-sd-23/jessica-scarcella-spanton.summary: Relates to information that residential health care facilities are required to separately disclose to residents and their families; requires such information to be posted on the residential health care facility's website.

ny-sd-23/jessica-scarcella-spanton.title: Enacts the "police radio transparency act"
ny-sd-23/jessica-scarcella-spanton.summary: Requires that any law enforcement agency in the state that encrypts any portion of its radio communications shall ensure that all of its radio communications, with the exception of sensitive information, may be monitored in real time by professional journalists, newscasters, and individuals employed by emergency services organizations.

ny-sd-23/jessica-scarcella-spanton.title: Relates to license fees required to be paid by wholesale beer licensees to sell cider
ny-sd-23/jessica-scarcella-spanton.summary: Requires wholesale beer licensees to only need to pay a one time additional license fee to sell cider.

ny-sd-23/jessica-scarcella-spanton.title: Enacts the responsible data center development act
ny-sd-23/jessica-scarcella-spanton.summary: Places a one year moratorium on the issuance of data center permits; requires utilities to establish an independent classification of service for large data centers; sets energy efficiency goals for data centers; provides for benefits for host communities; sets labor standards for the construction of data centers.

ny-sd-23/jessica-scarcella-spanton.title: Requires the division of criminal justice services to study the technological viability of personalized firearms
ny-sd-23/jessica-scarcella-spanton.summary: Enacts the "safer weapons, safer homes act"; requires the division of criminal justice services to study the technological viability of personalized firearms; defines personalized firearms; requires the division to report to the governor and the legislature on the results of the study.

ny-sd-23/jessica-scarcella-spanton.title: Promotes consumer choice by requiring manufacturers of digital electronic equipment to provide retail sellers with a one through ten repair score that will be displayed to consumers at point of sale
ny-sd-23/jessica-scarcella-spanton.summary: Promotes consumer choice by requiring manufacturers of digital electronic equipment to provide retail sellers with a repair score that will be displayed to consumers at point of sale.

ny-sd-23/jessica-scarcella-spanton.title: Relates to the taxation of vapor products
ny-sd-23/jessica-scarcella-spanton.summary: Relates to the taxation of vapor products; provides for the licensing of vapor products distributors; imposes certain tax return filing requirements on vapor products distributors; provides for enforcement powers.

ny-sd-23/jessica-scarcella-spanton.title: Relates to training for school security guards
ny-sd-23/jessica-scarcella-spanton.summary: Enacts the "school security guard training enhancement act"; provides that annual training where a security guard is employed or contracted by a school in this state shall require the completion of school specific-training.

ny-sd-23/jessica-scarcella-spanton.title: Relates to the municipal sustainable energy loan program
ny-sd-23/jessica-scarcella-spanton.summary: Relates to the municipal sustainable energy loan program regarding qualifying water improvements, qualifying resiliency improvements and, in a city with a population of one million or more, the use of low carbon intensity building components.

ny-sd-23/jessica-scarcella-spanton.title: Relates to the contents of emergency response plans required to be submitted to the public service commission by electric corporations
ny-sd-23/jessica-scarcella-spanton.summary: Relates to the contents of emergency response plans required to be submitted to the public service commission by electric corporations; requires such plans to include details of staffing, equipment, and ability to perform toward certain standards; requires the public service commission to establish a time-based restoration schedule.

ny-sd-23/jessica-scarcella-spanton.title: Establishes the artificial intelligence training data transparency act
ny-sd-23/jessica-scarcella-spanton.summary: Establishes the artificial intelligence training data transparency act requiring developers of generative artificial intelligence models or services to post on the developer's website information regarding the data used by the developer to train the generative artificial intelligence model or service, including a high-level summary of the datasets used in the development of such system or service.

ny-sd-23/jessica-scarcella-spanton.title: Enacts "the construction reporting pay act"
ny-sd-23/jessica-scarcella-spanton.summary: Enacts "the construction reporting pay act"; provides that each laborer, worker or mechanic in the employ of a contractor who by request or permission of an employer reports for work on any day shall be paid no less than four hours at the prevailing rate of wages.

ny-sd-23/jessica-scarcella-spanton.title: Permits funds collected from the Oswego county occupancy tax to be used on making tourism related capital improvements
ny-sd-23/jessica-scarcella-spanton.summary: Permits funds collected from the Oswego county occupancy tax to be used on making tourism related capital improvements; removes such tax on permanent residents.

ny-sd-23/jessica-scarcella-spanton.title: Designates dog control officers of the village of Holley, named by the village board as constables, as peace officers
ny-sd-23/jessica-scarcella-spanton.summary: Designates dog control officers of the village of Holley, named by the village board as constables, as peace officers.

ny-sd-23/jessica-scarcella-spanton.summary: Provides liability protections for health care providers who issue vaccines so long as such vaccination does not arise out of willful misconduct or gross negligence.

ny-sd-32/luis-sepulveda.title: Relates to the contents of emergency response plans required to be submitted to the public service commission by electric corporations
ny-sd-32/luis-sepulveda.summary: Relates to the contents of emergency response plans required to be submitted to the public service commission by electric corporations; requires such plans to include details of staffing, equipment, and ability to perform toward certain standards; requires the public service commission to establish a time-based restoration schedule.

ny-sd-32/luis-sepulveda.title: Establishes the artificial intelligence training data transparency act
ny-sd-32/luis-sepulveda.summary: Establishes the artificial intelligence training data transparency act requiring developers of generative artificial intelligence models or services to post on the developer's website information regarding the data used by the developer to train the generative artificial intelligence model or service, including a high-level summary of the datasets used in the development of such system or service.

ny-sd-32/luis-sepulveda.title: Enacts "the construction reporting pay act"
ny-sd-32/luis-sepulveda.summary: Enacts "the construction reporting pay act"; provides that each laborer, worker or mechanic in the employ of a contractor who by request or permission of an employer reports for work on any day shall be paid no less than four hours at the prevailing rate of wages.

ny-sd-32/luis-sepulveda.title: Permits funds collected from the Oswego county occupancy tax to be used on making tourism related capital improvements
ny-sd-32/luis-sepulveda.summary: Permits funds collected from the Oswego county occupancy tax to be used on making tourism related capital improvements; removes such tax on permanent residents.

ny-sd-32/luis-sepulveda.summary: Designates dog control officers of the village of Holley, named by the village board as constables, as peace officers.

ny-sd-32/luis-sepulveda.title: Provides liability protections for health care providers who issue vaccines

ny-sd-32/luis-sepulveda.title: Prohibits the use of surveillance pricing
ny-sd-32/luis-sepulveda.summary: Prohibits the use of surveillance pricing, directly or indirectly; prohibits the collection, use, retention, or sharing of data to facilitate surveillance pricing; provides exceptions; provides for enforcement by the attorney general; makes related provisions.

ny-sd-32/luis-sepulveda.title: Requires covered businesses to annually report to the department of labor regarding the impact of artificial intelligence on hiring and the nature of artificial intelligence use

ny-sd-59/kristen-gonzalez.summary: Designates dog control officers of the village of Holley, named by the village board as constables, as peace officers.

ny-sd-59/kristen-gonzalez.title: Provides liability protections for health care providers who issue vaccines
ny-sd-59/kristen-gonzalez.summary: Provides liability protections for health care providers who issue vaccines so long as such vaccination does not arise out of willful misconduct or gross negligence.

ny-sd-59/kristen-gonzalez.title: Prohibits the use of surveillance pricing
ny-sd-59/kristen-gonzalez.summary: Prohibits the use of surveillance pricing, directly or indirectly; prohibits the collection, use, retention, or sharing of data to facilitate surveillance pricing; provides exceptions; provides for enforcement by the attorney general; makes related provisions.

ny-sd-59/kristen-gonzalez.title: Requires covered businesses to annually report to the department of labor regarding the impact of artificial intelligence on hiring and the nature of artificial intelligence use
ny-sd-59/kristen-gonzalez.summary: Requires covered businesses to annually report to the department of labor regarding the impact of artificial intelligence on hiring and the nature of artificial intelligence use for the previous year; requires the department of labor to file an annual report on the impact of artificial intelligence on hiring and the nature of artificial intelligence use in the state; establishes penalties for covered business that fail to submit such reports.

us-house-ny-19/peter-oberacker.title: Relates to information that residential health care facilities are required to disclose to residents and their families
us-house-ny-19/peter-oberacker.summary: Relates to information that residential health care facilities are required to separately disclose to residents and their families; requires such information to be posted on the residential health care facility's website.

us-house-ny-19/peter-oberacker.title: Enacts the "police radio transparency act"
us-house-ny-19/peter-oberacker.summary: Requires that any law enforcement agency in the state that encrypts any portion of its radio communications shall ensure that all of its radio communications, with the exception of sensitive information, may be monitored in real time by professional journalists, newscasters, and individuals employed by emergency services organizations.

us-house-ny-19/peter-oberacker.title: Relates to license fees required to be paid by wholesale beer licensees to sell cider
us-house-ny-19/peter-oberacker.summary: Requires wholesale beer licensees to only need to pay a one time additional license fee to sell cider.

us-house-ny-19/peter-oberacker.title: Enacts the responsible data center development act
us-house-ny-19/peter-oberacker.summary: Places a one year moratorium on the issuance of data center permits; requires utilities to establish an independent classification of service for large data centers; sets energy efficiency goals for data centers; provides for benefits for host communities; sets labor standards for the construction of data centers.

us-house-ny-19/peter-oberacker.title: Requires the division of criminal justice services to study the technological viability of personalized firearms
us-house-ny-19/peter-oberacker.summary: Enacts the "safer weapons, safer homes act"; requires the division of criminal justice services to study the technological viability of personalized firearms; defines personalized firearms; requires the division to report to the governor and the legislature on the results of the study.

us-house-ny-19/peter-oberacker.title: Promotes consumer choice by requiring manufacturers of digital electronic equipment to provide retail sellers with a one through ten repair score that will be displayed to consumers at point of sale
us-house-ny-19/peter-oberacker.summary: Promotes consumer choice by requiring manufacturers of digital electronic equipment to provide retail sellers with a repair score that will be displayed to consumers at point of sale.

us-house-ny-19/peter-oberacker.title: Relates to the taxation of vapor products
us-house-ny-19/peter-oberacker.summary: Relates to the taxation of vapor products; provides for the licensing of vapor products distributors; imposes certain tax return filing requirements on vapor products distributors; provides for enforcement powers.

us-house-ny-19/peter-oberacker.title: Relates to training for school security guards
us-house-ny-19/peter-oberacker.summary: Enacts the "school security guard training enhancement act"; provides that annual training where a security guard is employed or contracted by a school in this state shall require the completion of school specific-training.

us-house-ny-19/peter-oberacker.title: Relates to the municipal sustainable energy loan program
us-house-ny-19/peter-oberacker.summary: Relates to the municipal sustainable energy loan program regarding qualifying water improvements, qualifying resiliency improvements and, in a city with a population of one million or more, the use of low carbon intensity building components.

us-house-ny-19/peter-oberacker.title: Relates to the contents of emergency response plans required to be submitted to the public service commission by electric corporations
us-house-ny-19/peter-oberacker.summary: Relates to the contents of emergency response plans required to be submitted to the public service commission by electric corporations; requires such plans to include details of staffing, equipment, and ability to perform toward certain standards; requires the public service commission to establish a time-based restoration schedule.

us-house-ny-19/peter-oberacker.title: Establishes the artificial intelligence training data transparency act
us-house-ny-19/peter-oberacker.summary: Establishes the artificial intelligence training data transparency act requiring developers of generative artificial intelligence models or services to post on the developer's website information regarding the data used by the developer to train the generative artificial intelligence model or service, including a high-level summary of the datasets used in the development of such system or service.

us-house-ny-19/peter-oberacker.title: Enacts "the construction reporting pay act"
us-house-ny-19/peter-oberacker.summary: Enacts "the construction reporting pay act"; provides that each laborer, worker or mechanic in the employ of a contractor who by request or permission of an employer reports for work on any day shall be paid no less than four hours at the prevailing rate of wages.
